title: Bytes to Threats: Byte-Sequence Transformer For Malware Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.18787v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing malware detection approaches heavily rely on handcrafted features derived from static or dynamic analysis of the executable files. These methods require specialized domain expertise, dedicated analysis tools, and time-consuming analysis, which limits their scalability and robustness in the face of the increasing complexity and diversity of modern malware. Consequently, there is a growing interest in approaches that operate directly on raw bytes, which contain rich semantic and structural information. However, capturing long-range dependencies within executable files remains challenging for conventional static and CNN-based methods. This paper presents MalwareFormer, a transformer-based, byte-level malware detection framework that operates directly on raw bytes, without requiring domain knowledge or feature extraction. translated_title: 从字节到威胁：用于恶意软件检测的字节序列Transformer
translated_abstract: 现有的恶意软件检测方法严重依赖于从可执行文件的静态或动态分析中提取的手工特征。这些方法需要专业的领域知识、专门的分析工具和耗时的分析过程，这限制了它们在面对日益复杂和多样化的现代恶意软件时的可扩展性和鲁棒性。因此，人们对直接处理原始字节的方法越来越感兴趣，因为原始字节中蕴含着丰富的语义和结构信息。然而，对于传统的静态方法和基于CNN的方法而言，捕获可执行文件内的长距离依赖关系仍然具有挑战性。本文提出了MalwareFormer，一个基于Transformer的字节级恶意软件检测框架，它直接在原始字节上运行，无需领域知识或特征提取。MalwareFormer达到了98.35%的准确率、98.32%的平衡准确率、98.32%的宏F1分数，以及假……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出MalwareFormer，一个基于Transformer的字节级恶意软件检测框架，无需领域知识或特征提取即可直接在原始字节上运行，实现了98.35%的准确率。
en_tdlr: MalwareFormer is a transformer-based, byte-level malware detection framework that operates directly on raw bytes without requiring domain knowledge or feature extraction, achieving 98.35% accuracy.
